### Bible Pathway - Feb. 9, 2011
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-9-2011-11645383.html
Passage: Leviticus 23:27-32
Points:
- The annual Day of Atonement required the high priest to offer sacrifices and enter the Holy of Holies alone.
- Israel was commanded to humble their souls and observe complete rest from all labor.
- The command against work producing sweat illustrates that human striving cannot earn God's favor.
- Jesus fulfills the Day of Atonement as our great High Priest, granting believers direct access to God.
